title: Unit Event — The Song of a Canary in Crisis — Episode3 What Goes Into A Show

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis
meta.Episode: Episode3 — What Goes Into A Show
meta.Event Outline: As the 30th Anniversary Show approaches, Nene is hard at work preparing for her role as the Cowardly Canary. However, during a rehearsal, the director criticizes not her acting, but her singing...

rows.Line: Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Incredible...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He really sounds like a powerful eagle. The master of this forest. His voice definitely does wanna make you dance and have fun...)

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Looks like Omori's been practicing.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: And he's totally different from his usual self. It's amazing how he's captured the eagle's awe-inspiring yet comical personality.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Nishie's also been doing an amazing job.
I love how her voice oozes with evil. She's been sending shivers down my spine as the witch.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not only do the main characters sing during this show, but each of the birds also has their own song.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It tests both an actor's singing and acting abilities, which suits the cast of the Phoenix Stage really well...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which sort of explains why it was chosen for the anniversary show. Needless to say, the crowd's gonna be looking forward to seeing us sing...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The way I sing could end up completely ruining our show...?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Precisely.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't let the way I sing ruin this show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to take a hard look at myself. I need to learn what my habits are...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because if I don't fix those, I'll never be able to sing like Omori. I have to see what the good singers are doing and find even the smallest hint.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I can do that, maybe. Just maybe...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Fine, so be it.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“I would rather not be a damper...
So, I shall make a special exception and sing for you.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Prepare every fiber of your being to hear the dulcet tones of my majestic voice.”

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Way to go, Sakurako.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Yeah.
She's definitely got another good one in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (How is she able to sing in such a compelling way?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This scene involves the phoenix showing the eagle her gratitude for helping her... But she sounds totally different compared to the beginning.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's so clear that the Phoenix is slowly opening up to the other birds through her interactions with Rio.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's being so delicate, but it also feels completely natural. My mind's convinced that she's...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That she's...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You've proven that you may be worthy of being our rivals. But you'll need to maintain this standard for your next show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(She wasn't kidding that time...
Which is why I began believing that I was on the same level as Sakurako Seiryuin...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Then, before I knew it...
She had run so far ahead that I can't see her anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I thought I was taking this so seriously...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But my confidence became so overinflated somewhere along the way that I'd lost sight...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I couldn't see just how much better everyone was getting...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(They kept improving. A lot...
And I'm only realizing that now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm such an idiot...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: “Diving into an unknown world is terrifying, but not being able to because of my own fears would be much worse!”

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: “I'm going! I need to see him...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Knowing all that, do I still want to...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I don't wanna give up...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(After hearing Seiryuin sing...
It felt like she was showing me just how much of a skill gap there is between us... And it was so painful.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But... But...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to accept that fact because I won't be able to move forward if I don't!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I can't look away. I have to watch, listen and figure out what I'm missing or doing wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I mean, Tsukasa won the role of Rio because he was willing to put himself through a lot.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Which means...
I also need to do absolutely everything I can to ensure that our show succeeds.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm gonna catch up to the others and show everyone that I am the Cowardly Canary...!)
